Name: Stardew Rivals
Author: Endwyr
Description:
[size=4][b]==Description==[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Allows certain NPCs to date eachother. I plan on introducing NPCs in pairs, each with their own file. Use each one as you wish. Ideally they will be independent from one another.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]==Special Instructions== [/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Marlon and Marnie:[/color][/size]
Requires a mod that adds Marlon to the game. I recommend my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22128]Valley NPCs[/url].

[b]==Features==[/b]
~Marlon & Marnie~
After Lewis & Marnie 6 Heart-event in town, Marnie starts having second thoughts about wanting to be kept a secret. Keep your eye out for a schedule change. An event will happen on that day, in Town (If you have 7 Hearts with Marlon & Marnie).
~Abigail & Sebastian~
After Abigail and Sebastian get 6 Hearts with the Farmer, they stop hanging out. But, after the Stardew Valley Band (Sam's 2-Heart event) preformed in Zuzu City (Sam's 8 Heart-event), they keep practicing. Witness the band get into a fight at practice to find out why two of its members are fighting. Watch the band break up. Become better friends with Sebastian and Abigail to witness the Band get back together, and watch the friends visit each other once again (8 Hearts with Sebastian and Abigail)

[b]==Why This Mod?==[/b]
For some reason when I play I feel like I'm tainting the game if I marry one of the Bachelors. Also, while I was learning to mod Stardew initially, I saw that many characters had a function that showed their "canon" partner. I decided then that I wanted them to all pair off. Marnie was paired with Marlon and the community has memes about her relationship with Lewis, so I decided to play with that. Also, I wanted to be able to see all of the 14-Heart events without having to marry and divorce every character, and then using roofie magic on them to make them forget we were ever together.

As with all of my mods, I like to be as Vanilla+ as possible, so I try to change or add as little as possible with these mods, while recycling and referencing as much as possible of the existing game.

==Changes==
Each Mod makes each character Undatable, and changes their 10-Heart to be non-romantic. It also makes their 14-Heart events into10-Heart events, and again not romantic. Think Lord of the Rings levels of bromance.
==Additions==
Each mod only adds 2 schedules max for each character, and a up to 2 Events.
